title: 50 Chinese Phrases in 11 Minutes | Learn Chinese for Beginners (Meeting People & Greetings)
description:
Learn 50 essential Chinese phrases in 11 minutes - the fun, fast way.
#Chinese #LearnChinese #LanguageLearning

Every phrase follows the same rhythm: hear it in English, hear it in 中文, then say it out loud with the pronunciation guide. Perfect for beginners, travellers and anyone who wants to speak Chinese with confidence.

WHAT YOU GET
- 8 themed chapters, 50 real-life phrases
- 中文 audio from a native voice
- English pronunciation guide for every line
- A brand-new lesson every single day

PHRASE LIST

MEETING PEOPLE & GREETINGS · 认识新朋友与问候
• Hi, I’m glad to meet you. - 你好，我很高兴认识你。  [Nǐ hǎo, wǒ hěn gāo xìng rènshi nǐ.]
• Nice meeting you, how’s it going? - 认识你真高兴，你最近怎么样？  [Rènshi nǐ zhēn gāo xìng, nǐ zuìjìn zěnme yàng?]
• I’m new here, what do you suggest? - 我第一次来，你建议我去哪儿玩？  [Wǒ dì yī cì lái, nǐ jiànyì wǒ qù nǎr wán?]
• What’s your name, if you don’t mind? - 你叫什么名字？如果不介意的话。  [Nǐ jiào shénme míngzì? Rúguǒ bù jièyì de huà.]
• Please forgive me, I forgot your name. - 不好意思，我刚才忘了你的名字。  [Bù hǎoyìsi, wǒ gāngcái wàng le nǐ de míngzi.]
• Do you prefer Chinese names or English? - 你更喜欢中文名字还是英文名字？  [Nǐ gèng xǐhuan zhōngwén míngzì háishì yīngwén míngzì?]
• How long have you lived here? - 你来这儿多久了？  [Nǐ lái zhèr duōjiǔ le?]

BALANCE · 平衡
• I ask, what matters most right now? - 我问自己，现在最重要的是什么？  [Wo WEN zi ji, XIAN zai Zui zhong yao de shi shen me?]
• I set limits, then I relax. - 我先设好界限，然后放松。  [Wo XIAN she hao jiè xiàn, RAN hou fang song.]
• Work mode, then reset to calm. - 工作模式用一会儿，接着回到平静。  [Gong zuo MO shi yong yi hui er, JIE zhe hui dao PING jing.]
• I breathe, then choose the kinder action. - 我先呼吸，再选更温和的做法。  [Wo XIAN hu xi, ZAI xuan geng wen he de zuo fa.]
• I don’t rush the ending I need. - 我不急着把结尾做完。  [Wo bu ji zhe ba jie wei zuo wan.]
• I drink water, my body thanks me. - 我喝点水，身体就会回应我。  [Wo he dian shui, shen ti jiu hui hui ying wo.]

PUBLIC TRANSPORTATION · 公共交通
• How long is the ride? - 到那里要多久？  [Dào nàli yào DUOJIU?]
• Is there a direct route? - 有没有直达的车？  [Yǒu méiyǒu zhídá de chē?]
• Is this the right platform? - 这是正确的站台吗？  [Zhè shì zhèngquè de zhàntái ma?]
• Does it get crowded later? - 后面会很挤吗？  [Hòumiàn huì hěn jǐ ma?]
• Can I bring a suitcase? - 我可以带行李吗？  [Wǒ kěyǐ dài XÍnglǐ ma?]
• Is Wi-Fi available on the train? - 地铁上有Wi-Fi吗？  [Dìtiě shàng yǒu Wi-Fi ma?]
• Where do I line up? - 我该在哪里排队？  [Wǒ gāi zài nǎlǐ pái duì?]

PATIENCE · 耐心
• I can take my time - 我可以慢慢来，没关系  [Wǒ kěyǐ màn man lái, méi guānxi]
• Let silence do its work - 先安静一下，别急着回应  [Xiān ānjìng yíxià, bié jí zhe huíyìng]
• Keep your pace, not your pressure - 稳住节奏，别把自己逼太紧  [Wěnzhù jiézòu, bié bǎ zìjǐ bī tài jǐn]
• Good answers come after practice - 多练几次，自然就会更好  [Duō liàn jǐ cì, zìrán jiù huì gèng hǎo]
• When it drags, breathe and reset - 拖一会儿也没事，先调整再继续  [Tuō yí huìr yě méi shì, xiān tiáozhěng zài jìxù]
• I’ll handle this step by step - 一步一步来，我不需要全都一次做好  [Yí bù yì bù lái, wǒ bù xūyào quán dōu yí cì zuò hǎo]

PHONE CALLS & MESSAGES · 电话与短信
• Are you still awake right now? - 你现在还醒着吗？  [Ni XIANZAI hai xingzhe ma?]
• Call me when you have a sec. - 你有空的话给我打个电话。  [Ni youkòng de hua gei wo da ge dianhua.]
• Your message made me pause. - 你那条消息让我停了一下。  [Ni na tiao xiaoxi rang wo ting le yixia.]
• I can’t talk yet, texting. - 我现在还不能打电话，我先发短信。  [Wo xianzai hai bu neng da dianhua, wo xian fa duanxin.]
• Did you see my last text? - 你看到我上条短信了吗？  [Ni kan dao wo shang tiao duanxin le ma?]
• I’m stepping out, I’ll reply later. - 我马上要出去啦，晚点再回你。  [Wo mashang yao chuqu la, wandian zai hui ni.]

COURAGE · 勇气
• Courage, I can handle this. - 勇气在这儿，我能应付。  [Yǒngqì zài zhèr, wǒ néng yìngfù.]
• Ask now, not when it hurts. - 现在就问，别等到更痛。  [Xiànzài jiù wèn, bié děng dào gèng tòng.]
• Stay kind, even when you push. - 你可以坚持，也要保持善意。  [Nǐ kěyǐ jiānchí, yě yào bǎochí shànyì.]
• Make the awkward call anyway. - 再尴尬也打出去吧。  [Zài gān'gà yě dǎ chūqù ba.]
• Say what you mean, clearly. - 把话说清楚，说到点上。  [Bǎ huà shuō qīngchǔ, shuō dào diǎnshang.]
• Let your yes sound like yes. - 你的答应就要像答应。  [Nǐ de dāyìng jiù yào xiàng dāyìng.]

WEATHER & SMALL TALK · 天气与闲聊
• Is it windy outside right now? - 现在外面风大吗？  [Xiànzài wàimian fēng dà ma?]
• The sun is strong today, huh? - 今天太阳有点猛啊。  [Jīntiān tàiyáng yǒudiǎn měng a.]
• I might need a light jacket. - 我可能得穿件薄外套。  [Wǒ kěnéng děi chuān jiàn báo wàitào.]
• Does it feel colder than yesterday? - 今天比昨天更冷吗？  [Jīntiān bǐ zuótiān gèng lěng ma?]
• Are you feeling the sunburn heat? - 你觉得晒得有点热吗？  [Nǐ juéde shài de yǒudiǎn rè ma?]
• My phone says the UV is high. - 我手机上显示紫外线很高。  [Wǒ shǒujī shàng xiǎnshì zǐwàixiàn hěn gāo.]

LOVE · 爱
• I’m proud to love you - 我很骄傲能爱你  [Wo HEN JIAO'AO NENG ai NI]
